GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: Distinct test function names required.
T1 and T2 (dfab-b219) both add tests to tests/scripts/test-ticket-create.sh as parallel Phase 1 roots. Additional AC: all new test functions in this task must have names prefixed 'test_16hex_' (e.g. test_16hex_stdout_format, test_16hex_event_filename). This avoids merge conflicts with T2's alias-prefixed test functions when both are committed independently.
